edges.reason: _msgSender() returns the untrusted msg.sender value to its callers.
transfer() passes _msgSender() as the sender into _transfer.
approve() uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transferFrom() uses _msgSender() as the spender for the allowance decrement.
increaseAllowance() uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
decreaseAllowance() uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
constructor assigns admin = msg.sender, granting an unchecked privileged role to the deployer.
withdraw() gate require(msg.sender == admin) derives from the caller-supplied address.
transfer() delegates execution to _transfer().
transferFrom() invokes _transfer() before updating the allowance.
transferFrom() invokes _approve() to decrease the spender allowance.
approve() delegates to _approve().
increaseAllowance() delegates to _approve().
decreaseAllowance() delegates to _approve().
constructor mints the initial supply by calling addBalance(admin, 5000e18).
_transfer() executes the burn arithmetic (amount.mul(burnFee).div(100), amount.sub(amountBurn)).
withdraw() reaches the external call msg.sender.transfer(address(this).balance).
The ETH transfer to msg.sender hands control to an attacker contract that can re-enter withdraw().
getFirstBlockTime() computes block.number - firstBlock, a block-number dependent value.
firstBlock feeds the anti-bot window check block.number < firstBlock + 20 inside _transfer().
firstBlock is the minuend in getFirstBlockTime()'s block-number arithmetic.
burnFee is the multiplier in the burn amount computation.
admin is compared with sender/recipient in _transfer() to bypass the burn for privileged addresses.
admin is the authority checked by withdraw().
admin receives the minted initial balance in addBalance().
firstTransfer gates the one-time initialisation of firstBlock inside _transfer().
_balances is read and written for sender and recipient inside _transfer().
_totalSupply is decreased by the burn amount inside _transfer().
addBalance() increases _totalSupply when minting.
addBalance() increases the account balance in _balances.
_approve() writes the owner/spender entry in _allowances.
transferFrom() reads _allowances to subtract the spent amount.
recipient parameter is forwarded by transfer().
amount parameter is forwarded by transfer().
sender parameter is consumed by _transfer() balance checks.
recipient parameter determines whose balance is credited in _transfer().
amount parameter drives the burn and balance arithmetic in _transfer().
amountRec is credited to the recipient in _transfer().
amountLimit bounds the accepted transfer amount during the anti-bot window.
amountBurn is the result of the burn arithmetic and is subtracted from supply.
sender parameter of transferFrom() is passed to _transfer().
recipient parameter of transferFrom() is passed to _transfer().
amount parameter of transferFrom() is passed to _transfer() and to the allowance subtraction.
spender parameter flows into _approve().
amount parameter flows into _approve().
spender parameter flows into _approve() via increaseAllowance().
addedValue is added to the current allowance.
spender parameter flows into _approve() via decreaseAllowance().
subtractedValue is subtracted from the current allowance.
account parameter receives the minted balance in addBalance().
amount parameter is added to both balance and total supply in addBalance().
owner parameter indexes the _allowances mapping written by _approve().

amountRec is a transient local derived and consumed entirely inside _transfer().
amountLimit is a constant-like local used only for the anti-bot check in _transfer().
amountBurn is the intermediate result of the unsafe burn arithmetic operation.
